notes.title: January 11, 2024 Update
notes.notes:
Thank you for playing Counterpact! Hopefully, you continue to enjoy the game. This update brings quite a few bug fixes and quality of life features, as well as a new weapon for Loie the Inker!


New Content:
New Loie the Inker weapon: Work In ProgressThis Defense weapon may not pack as much of a punch as some of her other weapons, but it can still cut through the competition (quite literally)! The sawblades it shoots penetrate enemies when initially shot, and can deny a small area upon hitting the environment. You can shoot oil at your enemies to make them slip into the sawblades, causing  them to be ignited when they get hit!New Gilded Gauntlet: OriginsHere's a not-so-friendly reminder that this is, indeed, a bullet hell. It's just you against Gale... and Gale? And also Gale? Let's hope your dodging skills are sharp!New Gilded Gauntlet Item: Shiniko the Reaper's Dollification


Balancing Adjustments:
The lower difficulties of the Gilded Spire no longer increase enemy attack delay, but instead decrease enemy health.The intention of this change is to emphasize the bullet hell focus of the Gilded Spire, as there seems to be common misunderstandings about what the Gilded Spire actually is, which in turn seems to lead to inefficient playstyles.


Bug Fixes:
Players who have not completely connected no longer appear on the scoreboard or in disconnect messages.Melee attacks no longer hit intangible enemies.Supernova missile detonation is now properly affected by delta time.Fixed an issue where the first unfavorited inventory emote and chair (the latter always being the Kitchen Chair) were being used as the default items in their respective menus.


Miscellaneous:
The AutoCam now prioritizes following the Security Cell in the Keepaway mode, so long as the Security Cell is not at "home".The "PlayerBypass" setting can now be added to the "Server" section of the INI to allow server hosts to set a player limit larger than 16.This setting is "secret" as large player numbers may have adverse effects; server hosts are responsible for any issues that are caused by using this setting.For security purposes, the internal limit is still capped at 50 players.KO streaks are now displayed on the scoreboard.Certain important buttons on the main menu and in-game menu now appear with different colors.Attempting to view the Gilded Gashapon's contents without having the Gilded Gauntlet unlocked will now display information about how to unlock the Gilded Gauntlet.An option has been added to adjust how long chat messages remain before fading out.An option has been added to automatically kick players who remain as spectators without chatting for extended periods of time.This is primarily to combat an issue where players would queue into matchmaking, then proceed to never join a team or participate in the game in any way, resulting in heavily lopsided games and generally wasting time for all those involved.

notes.title: January 2, 2024 Patch
notes.notes:
Bug Fixes:"NPC" no longer appears after Wardens are suddenly removed.Fixed an issue where some localization tags were not properly being sent by the account server.The Shop and Gashapon popups for new players no longer appear when the player is in the Gilded Spire, but has not yet selected a character.Custom settings will now properly set the collision masks for custom assets.
Miscellaneous:Unarchiving all items now displays a confirmation popup.

notes.title: December 17, 2023 Beta Patch
notes.notes:
Note: Unless there are any glaring issues that suddenly come up, this will be the final update before Counterpact's official launch on December 31! To those of you who have stuck around all this time, thank you for your support. However, this does mean that the Development Gashapon will be leaving soon, and the items within will no longer be obtainable. Hopefully you are satisfied with what you have.




Bug Fixes:
Performing actions within your inventory properly returns you to your previous page again.Delta time no longer negatively affects jump height.Certain visuals no longer cause underwater bubbles to fade out "randomly".Clients should no longer timeout while downloading larger maps directly from the server.
Balancing Adjustments:Unfathomable Fury's attack damage has been reduced.
Miscellaneous:Lifeguard's shield is now affected by item attribute filters, such as the Antique filter.Unique item icons have been added for Eclipsium bundles.Eclipsium bundles (and other items with "abnormal" recycling returns) now display how much is gained when recycling them on their item icons.Delta time has been implemented for important aspects of the game.The "Search" button has been removed from the inventory; text searching will now be performed automatically.Players can now search for multiple terms in their inventory by separating each search term with commas.Spacing has been added to Shortcake's background, better displaying the details on the sides of the background.The space between the edges of the water fountains and the ground on Treecave Greenhouse have been made solid.This is to prevent smaller players from going under the edge of the fountain and getting "stuck".Official map checksums are now run at the time of loading the map, instead of storing the checksum when the game is booted.

Bug Fixes:Holiday event decorations are now properly synchronized in demos.This fix should retroactively apply to demos.

New Variety Gashapon Items:Industrial Agriculture (Common Bulwark Outfit)Pest Control (Common Watcher Outfit)Cold Hearted (Common Dream Outfit)

Miscellaneous:Treecave Greenhouse, made by StarlessElaine, has been adopted as an official map.Dollification: Eye Blaster is now compatible with decorations and keychains.

notes.title: November 19, 2023 Beta Patch
notes.notes:
Balancing Adjustments:Gilded Gauntlet 3 (Closing In) now spawns an extra set of Wall Cutters on floor 4, instead of increasing the Wall Cutter size again. The extra set of Wall Cutters travels in the opposite direction.The explosion radius of Space Gun missiles has been decreased.Hypnotic Chain's pull strength now decreases slightly with each pull.This only applies to the currently-bound enemy; when binding a new enemy, the pull strength is reset.

Bug Fixes:No-Warden Areas no longer prevent players from removing Wardens.Fixed an issue where the list of current spectators was not being properly wrapped.Heartbeats nibs are now properly synchronized when hitting enemies.This bug had no effect on the weapon's functionality; it only interfered with visual clarity for remote players.

New Variety Gashapon Items:Cheerful Gorgon Girl (Uncommon Watcher Outfit)Budget Sprite (Common Reaper Outfit)Consolation (Common Angel Outfit)Flicker of Inspiration (Common Inker Outfit)

Miscellaneous:The menu button prompt no longer appears while spectating with the automated camera.Gilded Gauntlet weapon skins now include unique projectile sprites for attacks.Default emotes can now be bound to custom keyboard shortcuts.A button has been added to the in-game menu to toggle the automated camera while spectating.

notes.title: November 1, 2023 Beta Update
notes.notes:
New Content:The Gilded Gauntlet has been added.The Gilded Gauntlet is a series of challenges within the Gilded Spire that each offer extra difficulty beyond that of a standard Blinding run. Gauntlets will typically offer the standard Blinding rewards (65 Eclipsium and a gilded weapon), on top of rewarding the player with an Essence Remnant when the player completes a Gauntlet for the first time with a weapon within a given week.** Weapon skins are not counted separately.Essence Remnants are rewarded as items, but are a currency solely used by the Gilded Gashapon.There are currently 4 Gauntlets available; more Gauntlets will be added in future updates.The Gilded Gauntlet will not appear for players who do not own at least one gilded weapon.This is to prevent less skilled and less aware players from starting a Gauntlet without wholly knowing what that entails, as Gauntlets use the Blinding difficulty as a base.Despite the intention of this mechanic, players who have never completed Blinding themselves but obtained a gilded weapon from another player will be able to access the Gilded Gauntlet.The Gilded Gashapon is now permanently available, starting with the following items:Goliath Doll (Rare Pet)Gale Doll (Rare Pet)Gamble Doll (Rare Pet)Luster Mite Doll (Rare Pet)Snail Pulse (Rare Chair)Gilded Pretzel (Rare Chair)Goliath's Mallet & Shield* (Rare Lifeguard Weapon Skin)Gale's Coin Launcher* (Rare Future Shock Weapon Skin)Gamble's Striker Gun* (Rare Power Surge Weapon Skin)Gamble's Fury* (Rare Unfathomable Fury Weapon Skin)Dragon Edge* (Rare Firewall Weapon Skin)Wall Cutter* (Rare Back Alley Invitation Weapon Skin)Gold Coin Keychain (Rare Item)Platinum Coin Keychain (Rare Item)* Weapon skins from the Gilded Gashapon will not be rewarded when completing Blinding difficulty with them in the Gilded Spire.


Bug Fixes:Fixed an issue where pausing in the Gilded Spire would result in objects being hidden.Viewing an empty offer on a Trade Post now properly wraps the text.Mode-specific overlays are now properly hidden after a round ends.Intangible players are no longer able to be subdued.Players are no longer granted increasing rewards while playing with custom settings.Players are no longer able to bypass custom character limits after a round has ended.Disabling decorations no longer causes the game to crash when a weapon with a keychain attached is spawned.Pressing ESC while a menu or popup is already open in the Gilded Spire no longer opens up the in-game menu.

Balancing Adjustments:Scythe's and Soul Crusher's dash now only heals on hit for the amount of damage taken during the dash, as opposed to granting a small amount of extra healing should the damage reset threshold not be met.Graverobber now charges its dash quicker, but the dash inflicts less damage and lacks the damage reset mechanic Shiniko the Reaper's other weapons possess.Shazia the Dream's grapple strength while carrying a flag has been reduced.Hypnotic Chain's subduable application speed has been increased.Orbital Support now provides significantly less healing for the user.Intervention's attack damage has been slightly decreased.Intervention's Spirit gain rate has been slightly decreased.Unfathomable Fury's initial attack damage has been increased.Unfathomable Fury's spirit gain rate has been increased.Unfathomable Fury's overheat rate now decreases as it becomes overheated.The initial overheat rate is now higher than the previous rate.The final overheat rate is now lower than the previous rate.The Trick or Treat Candy's healing rate has been lowered significantly.

Miscellaneous:Holiday event names in item descriptions are now displayed in different colors.The Emote Bubble emote now appears as an empty emote bubble.An option has been added to cause allies to flicker when they are completely Hidden.This option is enabled by default.Voiceovers have been added for all other applicable characters, excluding Shiniko the Reaper and the Gilded Spire.Shiniko the Reaper and the Gilded Spire's voiceovers will be added in the near future.Announcers have been implemented.The Basic Announcer is selected by default, but those who prefer a more "dynamic" voice may select any one of the playable characters (excluding "Fhuuu" the Angel) as an announcer.For the sake of stability, Shiniko the Reaper is currently listed as an available announcer; however, selecting her will use the Basic Announcer until her voiceovers become available.Small arrows now appear above allied Graverobber treasures.KO streaks are now announced in the event feed for every 5 KO's achieved.The loss of a KO streak is also announced in the event feed.

notes.title: October 1, 2023 Beta Patch
notes.notes:
Bug Fixes:Offensive Gilded Spire enemies no longer stop moving if the player positions themselves a certain way.Fixed an issue that was causing the trade post confirmation's text to overflow.A measure to prevent outfits and weapons from not being properly initialized has been implemented.Fixed account mutes not working properly.Archiving items no longer causes items of the same type to be archived if they are currently involved in trading.Corrected some strings that were not properly converted to the localization system.Restarting a demo no longer causes adverse issues, such as game crashes.Fixed an issue that was causing account server errors and messages to not be properly interpreted.Fixed a bug that was causing KOunters with backgrounds (such as the Scoreboard KOunter) to put extra space between it and status effect icons.
Balancing Adjustments:Napalm now causes slight heal fatigue to be inflicted upon taking damage.The amount of heal fatigue inflicted depends on the current level of Napalm.
Miscellaneous:Voiceovers have been implemented for "Fhuuu" the Angel and the Gilded Spire enemies.Voiceovers will be implemented for other characters as they become available; all voiceovers will be available by launch.First time players are now asked if they would like to use their Steam account to register a Counterpact account.The Antique filter is now applied to "extra" parts of weapons, such as Shazia the Dream's chains.The image selection buttons in the map editor have been replaced with a slider.The Overtime Boost display in the Gilded Spire now becomes redder as it approaches 100%.The heal fatigue icon on the overlay now displays the current percentage of heal fatigue, rather than the current percentage of healing received.This was done to both be less confusing for newer players, and to make it more consistent with how other status effects are displayed.

notes.title: Autumn Equinox Event - September 11, 2023 Beta Patch
notes.notes:
New Variety Gashapon Items:


Falling Fashion (Common Holiday Loadout Outfit)*Bountiful Harvest (Common Holiday Bounty Hunter Weapon Skin)*Maple Leaf (Common Holiday Emote)*Pumpkin Pie (Common Holiday Chair)*Candy Apple (Common Holiday Pet)*




* These items are only available during the Autumn Equinox event, which will run from September 11 to September 25. Autumn Equinox 2022's items have also returned to the Variety Gashapon for this period of time. Three Decorations exclusive to Autumn Equinox are also obtainable during this event.





Miscellaneous:


Internal changes have been made regarding the synchronization of status effects.The impact of this should be relatively unnoticeable on the surface, but it does improve synchronization and will result in less total packet size.Due to this change, previously recorded demos are now incompatible with the current version of the game.The remaining text has been converted to the localization system; all text is now able to be localized.The Account Management menu is now accessible in-game; however, options related to logins will be unavailable while in-game.The Antique attribute has been added to all holiday event items that were acquired through the first event in which they appeared, excluding Mementos.Going forward, all holiday event items (excluding Mementos) will be obtained with the Antique attribute during the first holiday event in which they appear.The following items have had the Antique attribute retroactively added:Halloween 2022 items (excluding the Pumpkin Bucket Charm)Festive Season 2022 items (excluding the Holiday Wreath Charm)Lunar New Year 2023 itemsSpring Equinox 2023 itemsCar InsuranceSummer Solstice 2023 items (excluding the Sportsball Trophy Medal Charm)This does not include Super Solstice 2022 items obtained in the Summer Solstice 2023 event.Attempting to purchase an item with insufficient Eggshells will now offer to direct the player to the Little Egg Basket Ko-fi.

notes.title: August 14, 2023 Beta Patch
notes.notes:
Balancing Adjustments:The Eclipsium reward for playing on servers with custom settings has been significantly reduced.The reworked Hypnotic Chain now inflicts the subduable status more slowly against targets with an imbalance buff.
Bug Fixes:Fixed manually switching to a specific map not working if the rotation only consisted of one map.Orbital Support no longer inflicts acid or knockback on allies.Subduing no longer inflicts attack damage.This had very little gameplay impact; it would simply cause the damage counter to display more damage than the total health of the victim, though it would also award that extra bit of damage to the score.Fixed the reworked Hypnotic Chain appearing to begin its decay earlier for other players.This did not have any impact on usability; it was solely an issue of clarity.Fixed pets not following their owners during high latency or disconnects.Fixed an issue where a subdue KO would sometimes be missing its special effects for other net players.
Miscellaneous:The appearance of the Model 9 outfit has been redone.Due to issues surrounding the original appearance of the outfit, the original appearance will not be making a return under any circumstance.The reworked Hypnotic Chain now displays its subdue meter regardless of whether an enemy is chained.Shazia the Dream's demonstration has been updated to accurately reflect the reworked Hypnotic Chain.

notes.title: Quality of Life Update
notes.notes:
Note: Due to certain internal changes, previously recorded demos are no longer playable.


Balancing Adjustments:
Unfathomable Fury cooling rate has been slightly increased.Hypnotic Chain's subdue rate is now affected by the user's distance from their target.This rate scales based on current distance, with the rate being faster the closer the user is to the target.At a distance of half of the maximum chain length, the subdue rate will match the previous subdue rate.If the user is right next to the target, the rate will be slightly faster.If the user is the maximum distance away from the target, the rate will be significantly slower.

Bug Fixes:
The refined sheen and Gilded glitter effects have been disabled until further notice due to compatibility issues.The Random Team button is no longer selectable when playing a demo.The Vote Skip button is no longer selectable when playing a demo.

Miscellaneous:
The ball is now affected by motion-inflicting map entities, such as launch areas.Item searches and the current page are now retained if the popup is reopened, such as when archiving items.Items can now be searched for by their abbreviations.Due to the way this is implemented, certain words that are often excluded from abbreviations (such as "the") are still counted in abbreviations in this instance.The inventory's "reset filters" button now also clears the current search term.Individual items can now be manually unarchived through the Account Management menu.Gale's coins now rapidly blink during the last second of their lifespan.Entities in the map editor can no longer be manually locked; instead, they are only able to be deleted while the tool is selected or if Control is being held.The Credits have been revamped.The visual overlay when being subdued has been adjusted; at the start of subduing the effects are very subtle, but become significantly more intense when the victim is close to being subdued.The Space Bar can now be used to pause or play demos.
